capabilities: Add image thumbnails to Bases cards, kanban, table and list views
Save thumbnails from drops, pastes, URLs, Cloudflare R2 or Eagle
Color, rename and add Bases groups
Format table headers, columns, rows and cells per theme
Zoom views, fold groups and move through tables like a spreadsheet
disambiguation: Not just a skin for Bases: it also saves thumbnails from five sources, renames groups and adds spreadsheet-style table navigation.
extras: No telemetry; network use only when requested (image download, R2 upload, Eagle on localhost). Settings and formats live in the .base file; removing the plugin keeps thumbnails and fitted widths. Needs Obsidian 1.13+ (kanban 1.14+).
intentEvidence: No separate view or interface: your bases stay plain Bases, they just look and work better.
problem: Core Bases views offer no image thumbnails, group colors or cell formatting, and adding an image forces switching views.

relations.evidence: Import from CMDS Eagle in the settings copies its R2 settings
or pick from the Eagle app
upload to Cloudflare R2, or pick from the Eagle app
A YouTube link becomes the video's preview image

summary: Addon that adds image thumbnails, group colors and spreadsheet-style table tools to Obsidian's core Bases views.
